title: Hi, I am Rahul
sub_title: Data Scientist | GEN AI, ML| 13+ yrs SW, 9+ yrs Gen AI & ML
content: With over 13 years in the software industry and 9+ years dedicated to Data Science, GenAI, and Machine Learning, I am at the forefront of Generative AI innovation. I specialize in turning complex data challenges into actionable, scalable solutions for the financial sector. My recent work focuses on pioneering LLM-based solutions, including development of an advanced Low-code Platform (MCP) to accelerate React and React Native app development, building a sophisticated Agentic communication system using an actor-reviewer pattern to enhance codebase intelligence, and creating a financial chatbot with automated workflows like invoice parsing. Beyond GenAI, my expertise includes Explainable AI/ML models for transparency in decision-making, Synthetic Tabular Data Generator ensuring privacy and security, and exploration of emerging technologies like Rust and Mojo for scientific computing. I'm currently seeking to contribute to cutting-edge ML and DL projects, advancing AI models, and implementing large-scale ML solutions.

projects.title: Gen AI Development
projects.functionalities: Architected a low-code, GenAI-driven platform automating 80% of app development from Figma designs via multi-agent coordination and stateful workflows, significantly reducing manual effort and accelerating delivery times.
roles: Pioneered an LLM-powered developer-agent interaction framework using LiteLLM for stateful orchestration, enabling efficient code extraction, review, and refactoring with automated knowledge transfer across development cycles

Designed and deployed a stateful financial support chatbot using Pydantic AI, integrated with multi-agent pipelines for query understanding, compliance verification, and Financial Transaction posting enhancing customer experience
Developed advanced Low-code Platform using MCP/AG-UI protocol to accelerate React and React Native app development with multi-agent coordination

projects.title: AutoML Platform & Synthetic Data Generator
projects.functionalities: Developed a statistical equivalent Synthetic Tabular Data Generator without GANs/Autoencoders, enabling secure financial data sharing. Built a fully functional AutoML platform supporting regression, classification, and time series forecasting with explainability.
roles: Created Synthetic Tabular Data Generator tailored for banking domain ensuring privacy and security
Integrated multiple time series forecasting packages into AutoML platform
Implemented explainable AI models to enhance transparency in complex decision-making

projects.title: Retail ML Solutions - Item/Buddy Matching & Product Detection
projects.functionalities: Developed ML models for retail demand/supply, recommendations, pricing, and customer experience. Built item clustering systems using textual and image information for merchandise organization and product identification using YOLO object detection.
roles: Implemented clustering algorithms using textual information for product similarity matching
Developed object detection models using YOLOV3 for empty shelf detection and product recognition
Created associative rule mining systems to find item associations for planogram optimization
Built scalable ML systems for production deployment and monitoring

projects.title: Core Banking Solution [ CBS ]
projects.functionalities: Execution of core banking system across all branches and speed up all financial transactions, automation of EOD interests calculation and offline reporting.
roles: Enhancements for interest calculation for loan products.
Change request implementation for parameter change, customer level limit tree creation, NPA, Financial transaction.
